envelope.description: Team types, PATHS entry and policy-file parser

body.title: Team types, PATHS entry and policy-file parser
body.summary: Add the ~/.insrc/team directory entry to PATHS in src/shared/paths.ts, and create src/workflow/team/ with the types (TeamPolicy including source.anchorKnown, PolicyResult, PolicyAnchor, PolicyRefreshOutcome) and the parser that validates .insrc/policy.json against the authored-fields schema (teamMode, signoffStages, claimsEnforced, administrators), rejecting unknown fields, wrong types, and files carrying claimUnits, forceTaskIssues or source, and that derives claimUnits and forceTaskIssues itself.
acceptanceChecks: A valid policy file parses to a TeamPolicy with the fixed claimUnits and forceTaskIssues true.
Bad JSON, an unknown field, a wrong type, or a file carrying claimUnits, forceTaskIssues or source is rejected with a reason.
PATHS exposes the team directory used by the sighting store.
